content:

“The horse was subjected to veterinary examination. On examination, it was found to have suffered from heat stress and was stiff on its hind quarters. Subsequently on 18th June, 2026, the Club’s Veterinary Officer reported that the horse had sustained complete hip bone fracture and hence was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.”

He was probably perfectly fine until he was not. They call it an accident, and there’s nothing the officials could have done to save him.

title: Horseracing calls this a success story
author: Erase Horseracing India
excerpt: MARGARETTA won ₹59.4 lakh for her exploiters. It cost her a left eye injury.
content:
MARGARETTA, a 3-year-old horse, won ₹59.4 lakh for her exploiters. But that came at a cost for her.
“Classy Margaretta is the New Queen”
“Margaretta Makes a Mockery of the Opposition”
“Margaretta shows her class in the Zavaray S. Poonawalla Fillies Championship Stakes” 
These were the headlines. Margaretta was celebrated by the industry since she had won races consecutively.

The “winner” horse, MARGARETTA, suffered a left eye injury due to kickbacks in the race.

Such injuries are inevitable in horseracing, because in every race, horses are treated like money-making machines, and not as sentient beings. It’s beyond doubt that racehorse welfare is a sham and this industry only cares about profits.

We have witnessed “winners” like GOLD DANCER [breaking his back](https://www.animalaid.org.uk/campaigns/ban-horse-racing/horse-of-the-week/gold-dancer/) at the Grand National, UK and HALF YOURS [bleeding from his mouth](https://7news.com.au/sport/horse-racing/vets-explain-blood-coming-from-the-mouth-of-half-yours-at-finish-line-of-melbourne-cup-the-horse-is-fine-c-20580604) at the Melbourne Cup, Australia creating public outrage and calling for an end to this evil industry. These injuries occurred on live television with thousands of people watching, and the industry could not hide or hope to be ignored.

These are not isolated incidents. They are symptoms of a system built on exploitation.

What about the racehorses killed every other day?
What about the hundreds of injuries they suffer every day?
What about the thousands kept in "solitary confinement" for over 23 hours a day?

Let’s question the exploitation.

Don’t watch. Don’t attend. Don't bet.
Boycott horseracing.

Video source: TCG Studioz

Source: BTC

title: The Life of a Racehorse
author: Erase Horseracing India
excerpt: Debunking a documentary on the life of a jockey: racehorses are not athletes, and speed does not justify control.
content:
The Deccan Herald released a documentary on the “[Life of a Jockey](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/z25PYPVLm4A),” which got some facts wrong. Let me debunk those.

- **Not Athletes, but Slaves:** The industry likens horses to athletes and machines with "bigger engines." This reduces sentient beings to mere objects for entertainment. It is unapologetic exploitation.
- **Speed Does Not Justify Control:** A horse's natural speed is weaponized against them. Their ability to run gives no one the right to breed, confine, or command them. How is this different from [selling young girls](https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-30189014) for money in the name of marriage and reducing them to baby-making machines?
- **The Truth of Their Confinement:** The industry boasts about specialized diets. The reality is [horrific confinement.](https://horseracingwrongs.org/2022/09/01/the-evil-yes-evil-of-racehorse-confinement/) Racehorses are locked in stalls for 21 to 23 hours a day, fed unnatural diets, and denied all social interaction.
- **Pain for Profit:** While horseshoeing itself may not inflict pain, the whipping during races certainly does. They are beaten publicly for cheers and gambling. Behind the glamour, innocent and defenseless animals are abused.

This is the life of a racehorse!

Don’t watch. Don’t bet. Don’t attend.
**Boycott horseracing**

title: Sport vs. Slavery
author: Erase Horseracing India
excerpt: Human athletes are driven by free will. Horses are driven by the whip, confinement, injuries, and fear.
content:
What makes a sport... a sport? A sport is a display of human qualities, a symbol of empowerment and liberation. Most importantly, a choice to test one’s limits.
Human athletes are driven by passion, discipline, and free will. While horses are driven by the whip, confinement, injuries, and fear.
They are bred and forced to run for profit. Behind every race is a life treated as a commodity, discarded the moment they can no longer perform.
To all who justify horse racing as a sport, would you truly trade places with them?
Don’t watch. Don’t attend. Don't bet.
Boycott horseracing

title: Is Horseracing Always Cruel?
author: Erase Horseracing India
excerpt: Yes. Cruelty in horseracing isn’t about “bad trainers” or “isolated accidents.” It’s systemic.
content:
Yes. And here’s why.
Cruelty in horseracing isn’t about “bad trainers” or “isolated accidents”, it’s systemic.
Horses do not consent to race.
Their bodies are controlled through whips, mouth bits, tight nosebands, blinkers, spurs, confinement, and forceful training regimes designed to override fear, pain, and self-preservation.

Injuries, stress, fractures, bleeding lungs, and fatalities are not rare anomalies, they are an expected cost of pushing animals beyond their physical limits for speed, profit, and entertainment.

When suffering is routine, restraint is normalized, and risk of death is built into the activity, calling it “sport” doesn’t make it ethical.

You cannot regulate cruelty into kindness.
You cannot dress violence up as tradition.
And there is no right way to do a wrong thing.

Horses deserve freedom, not exploitation.

Don’t watch. Don’t bet. Don’t attend.
Boycott horseracing

title: No More Horseracing in Tamil Nadu, India
author: Erase Horseracing India
excerpt: Horseracing has ended at Chennai's Guindy racecourse and in Ooty, as Tamil Nadu turns both racecourses into eco parks.
content:
On December 1, 2025, the [Madras Race Club at Guindy, Chennai](https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/chennai-desperately-needs-eco-park-at-madras-race-club-land-in-guindy-madras-high-court/article70344240.ece), effectively shut down horseracing after the Madras High Court allowed the Tamil Nadu Government to convert the Guindy racecourse into an Eco Park, prioritizing flood mitigation, environmental restoration, and public interest over horseracing, ending 248 years of this animal exploitation in Chennai.

Last year, the [Ooty Racecourse](https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/tamil-nadu/2025/Mar/15/tn-budget-2025-reclaimed-ooty-race-course-to-be-developed-as-eco-park-at-rs-70-crore) was permanently shut after the Tamil Nadu Government reclaimed 53 acres from the Madras Race Club over unpaid lease arrears. With the Supreme Court of India affirming, the 2025 TN budget announcement confirmed that the land will be transformed into an Eco Park, effectively ending horseracing in Ooty for good.

In 2025, for the first time, there was
No summer season in Ooty
No winter season in Chennai

It is just the fall season for the industry from now on.

Which racecourse will shut down next?

title: THIS. IS. IT.
author: Erase Horseracing India
excerpt: A horse's voice imagined through poetry, followed by what happened to BALTIMORE at the Bangalore racecourse.
content:
THIS. IS. IT. I will never again obey.
These men have made me their prey.
I have endured unspeakable abuse.
They inflict more pain if I refuse.

For eight years, I’ve lived in a tiny room,
Let outside for only a few hours to groom.
There are hundreds more like me,
Living in isolation with no chance to flee.

Here I am, strapped up with a number,
For the 44th time, if I rightly remember.
As I walk through the cheering crowd,
My abusers arrive, all looking so proud.

They say I dare not lift my head,
Nor speak a word, or I’d be dead.
They force sixty kilos on my back,
And a metal bit to keep me on track.

Last time, I was clinging to my life.
Every step I took cut me like a knife.
Burning up, suffocating, and scared,
I ran so fast, but I still wasn’t spared.

This time, I rebel before entering the gate,
Push off the man who controls my fate.
I dare to take back my freedom now,
’Cause it's my right, and I will not bow.

I bolt in the other direction with all my might,
To only see rails, walls and gates sealed tight.
The angry men come chasing after me desperately,
Tired and with nowhere to go, I stand helplessly.

They tie me up and beat me down,
But you think I always wear a crown.
Now you know how this exploitation ends,
For me, my family, and my friends.

They call me by the name BALTIMORE.
They treat me like an object; nothing more.
Yet I will never give up and will always try.
A horse is not a slave; so neither am I.

On 28th November 2025, at the Bangalore racecourse and on the way to the starting gates, “BALTIMORE (an 8-year-old mare), bolted, dropped the rider, and thereafter, ran in an anti-clockwise direction, on the inner sand track.” She was declared “withdrawn” from the race.

A race that would have been her 44th.
A race that would have made her relive her worst fears.
A race that would have even killed her.

So, she fought back. She was defeated. But this won’t end in vain.

Don’t watch. Don’t bet. Don’t attend.
Boycott horseracing

Source: BTC

title: Horseracing = Suffering and Slavery
author: Erase Horseracing India
excerpt: Animal rights activists bore witness to the suffering of racehorses outside Pune racecourse.
content:
Pune animal rights activists bore witness to the cruelty in the horseracing industry outside the Pune racecourse, when the racehorses that were just forced to run were taken back to their stables. The horses were visibly breathless and profusely sweating under the extremely hot sun. Their young bodies clearly suffered under this abuse, and their free spirits were in shackles. See it for yourself.

A horse with a bit in their mouth is not free.
A horse dragged, beaten, drugged, and confined is not free.
Call it tradition if you want…
But slavery by any name is still slavery.
Nobody has the right over their bodies.

title: Pune Protest Revisited
author: Erase Horseracing India
excerpt: Animal liberation activists gathered again in Pune to demand the complete abolition of horse racing in India.
content:
**Animal Liberation Activists Protested Against Horseracing After the Killing of Superluminal**

**On the 2nd of November, 2025, in front of the Pune racecourse,** in a powerful show of solidarity, a group of animal liberation activists gathered to demand the complete abolition of horse racing, a.k.a. enslavement of horses in India. The protest was jointly organized by **Erase Horseracing India** and **Animal Liberation Activists from Pune**, following the recent tragic killing of **Superluminal**, a four-year-old racehorse who suffered a broken left foreleg during a “race” at the Pune Racecourse and was subsequently killed on **October 12th, 2025**.

The protest began with a short recitation on the life and suffering of Superluminal in the horse racing industry by liberationist **Sahil**, drawing attention to the exploitation and violence hidden behind the glamour and gambling of horse racing.

The protestors were holding placards calling out the objectification and enslavement of horses and then chanted slogans in English, Hindi, and Marathi. *“Shattered limbs and heart attacks. Close down these racetracks”, "आवाज उठाये कब तक? चाबुक चलेगा जब तक!" , "शर्यत सोडा, न्याय जोडा!" & "नुसतच म्हणतात काळजी हाय, पैशे देतात तोडायला पाय"* Leaflets detailing the industry’s cruel practices were distributed to the public, pressing them not to bet, attend, or support horse racing.

“Superluminal’s death is not an “unfortunate accident”, it’s the inevitable outcome of an industry built on the oppression and exploitation of sentient beings,” said **Aakash**, one of the protesters leading the slogans.

"सुपरल्युमिनलचा मृत्यू हा "दुर्दैवी अपघात" नाही, तर तो संवेदनशील प्राण्यांच्या अत्याचार आणि शोषणावर उभारलेल्या उद्योगाचा अपरिहार्य परिणाम आहे," असे घोषणाबाजीचे नेतृत्व करणारा निदर्शक **आकाश** म्हणाला.

“Horses are confined for over 21 hours a day, whipped into submission, and killed or discarded as waste when no longer profitable. Research shows that post-race, 99% of the racehorses suffer from Exercise Induced Pulmonary Haemorrhage (EIPH), which is bleeding in their lungs. If a sport harms its “athletes” (slaves) to this extent, then the only just action is to **eradicate** it,” said **Nitharshni** from Erase Horseracing India.

Another activist added, “If we truly care about animals, we must not turn a blind eye to their exploitation on racetracks. ‘It is high time we end the crime’ and hold the elite class involved in horse racing accountable for the slavery they continue to partake in.”

एक अन्य कार्यकर्ता ने कहा, "अगर हम सचमुच जानवरों की परवाह करते हैं, तो हमें रेसट्रैक पर उनके शोषण को नज़रअंदाज़ नहीं करना चाहिए। 'अब समय आ गया है, हम इस अपराध को जड़ से खत्म करें!' और घुड़दौड़ में शामिल अभिजात वर्ग को उस गुलामी के लिए जवाबदेह ठहराया जाना चाहिए जिसमें वे भागीदार हैं।"

**“What do we want? Animal Liberation! When do we want it? NOW!”** all the activists chanted in unison.

This brutal killing is not an isolated incident. In 2023, Victory Chant, a 4-year-old horse, fell during a “race” and was found to have a fractured right shoulder; murdered. In 2024, Deo Volente, a 3-year-old horse, suffered a hip fracture; murdered. Later the same year, Golden Neil, a 5-year-old horse, broke both fore fetlock joints mid-race; murdered. These repeated confirmed fatalities expose the inherent cruelty of horse racing, where catastrophic injuries and deaths are routinely dismissed as part of the sport.

वारंवार होणाऱ्या मृत्यूंमुळे घोड्यांच्या शर्यतीतील अंतर्निहित क्रूरता उघड होते, जिथे प्राणघातक दुखापती आणि मृत्यूंना खेळाचा भाग म्हणून नियमितपणे नाकारले जाते.

“In the wake of Superluminal’s death, we are calling for **immediate action** from the authorities & the stakeholders to **abolish horse racing altogether** because all the horses involved are victims of enslavement & exploitation for human entertainment. We also advocate to the public to **boycott all animal products and services built on slavery** **and the commodification of non-human animals,** & to **stand up for the liberation of defenseless animals**,” said the lead protestor, **Sahil**.

"सुपरल्यूमिनल की मौत के मद्देनज़र, हम अधिकारियों और हितधारकों से घोड़ों की दौड़ को पूरी तरह से खत्म करने के लिए तत्काल कार्रवाई करने का आह्वान कर रहे हैं, क्योंकि इसमें शामिल सभी घोड़े मानव मनोरंजन के लिए गुलामी और शोषण के शिकार हैं। प्रमुख प्रदर्शनकारी साहिल ने कहा, "हम जनता से गुलामी और गैर-मानव जानवरों की बिक्री पर आधारित सभी पशु उत्पादों और सेवाओं का बहिष्कार करने और बेजुबान जानवरों की मुक्ति के लिए खड़े होने का आग्रह करते हैं।"

Don’t watch. Don’t bet. Don’t attend.

घोड्यांच्या शर्यतीचा बहिष्कार करू

Boycott horseracing

title: RIP BLACK MAGICIAN
author: Erase Horseracing India
excerpt: A two-year-old horse was killed after his body gave in to the strain imposed by racing.
content:
2nd horse was killed this year at Pune Racecourse on November 2, 2025.

Black Magician was just a 2-year-old, born on April 18, 2023, at Star Born Stud Farm in Punjab.
He was taken from his mother, Sea Lagoon, long before he was ready, denied the chance to grow up in a herd, as horses do in nature.

Instead, he spent most of his short life confined in a stable.
When he was “broken in,” the bit forced into his mouth and a rider placed on his back, he ran; not out of choice, but out of fear, driven by his prey instinct.

His body, bred to be lighter and faster, could not withstand the strain.
It crushed under the pressure and so did his life prematurely as he was deemed no longer profitable by this vile industry, that enslaves horses.

Don’t watch. Don’t bet. Don’t attend.

title: RIP SUPERLUMINAL
author: Erase Horseracing India
excerpt: A four-year-old filly was killed after suffering a catastrophic breakdown during a race at Pune.
content:
SUPERLUMINAL, a 4 year old filly killed on 12th October 2025 at Pune racecourse.

The race day report read, “Passing the 500 metres, SUPERLUMINAL (R. Shelar) lost its footing, broke down and dislodged its rider, the filly was examined by the Club’s Sr. V.O. and was found to be recumbent with broken left fore radius bone with open fracture which was not repairable. As such, with the due consent of Trainer Ivor Fernandes the filly was euthanized on humanitarian grounds.”

Her death was NOT HUMANE!

Her death was blood wetting the grass.
Her death was cries of agony muted by the cheers.
Her death was fear of dying without ever being able to run free.

This vile, selfish, and despicable atrocity towards helpless horses is what horseracing truly is.

title: Terror Behind Glamour
author: Erase Horseracing India
excerpt: A six-year-old horse panicked in the starting gate at Pune racecourse, suffering visible injury before the race even began.
content:
Moments before the start of the race at Pune racecourse on 21 September 2025, DIVINE INTUITION (6-year-old) panicked inside the starting stall.
He reared up and fell backwards. He struggled to get back on his feet. His suffering and fear were caught on the racing video.
When examined, he was found bleeding from his left nostril.

Injuries at the starting gates are all too common. Horses are hardwired to avoid tight, enclosed spaces where they can’t see escape routes. A starting gate is narrow, metallic, loud, and confining; everything that triggers a horse’s flight instinct. The clanging of the metal gates, shouting handlers, loudspeakers, and the presence of other horses all increase anxiety. When the gates open suddenly with a loud bang, many horses panic, rear, or leap sideways.

Horses that hesitate to enter are often pushed, tugged, or hit to enter the stall. Some are even fitted with blinkers or hoods to reduce resistance, and it is not to calm them, but to confuse or desensitize them.

Horses don’t choose to race. They’re confined, coerced, and terrorized to do so.
And, this is what the horseracing industry hides behind glamour and gambling.

Don’t watch. Don’t bet. Don’t attend.
Boycott horseracing

Source: RWITC
